Sensei Studio BJJ in Tannersville

Sensei Sandy BJJ is a small, coach-led training room for kids, teens, and adults. Visit the mats, see how the room works, and decide whether the pace feels right before choosing a class.

Know the room before your first class

Mats, viewing, and cleanliness

The training area is built around clean mats, clear coaching, and enough space for partners to work safely. A small waiting area sits immediately outside the training room, and students learn the room’s safety expectations before live resistance begins.

Mats and high-touch surfaces are cleaned as part of the studio routine. Class sizes stay intentionally small so Sandy can see the room and adjust instruction to the students present.

Kids, teens, and adults

Kids and teens share the scheduled Youth + Teen class, with partners and coaching adjusted to the student. Adults can start without prior experience, athletic credentials, or a competition goal. The first visit is paced as a coached learning experience.

View the current schedule

Entrance, parking, and arrival

The studio is at 6045 Main Street, 2nd Floor, Tannersville, NY 12485, inside Studios on Main. Use the building landmark and arrival instructions shared before your visit, then follow the route to the second floor.

Arrival details and any door instructions are shared before a scheduled first visit. If you need help planning the route, text Sandy before you drive.

See directions and parking

A low-pressure first visit

Your Free First Visit is a chance to meet the coach, see the room, talk through your goals, and learn what the first class will feel like. No experience is required, and you can ask questions before deciding on a weekly rhythm.

A clean, orderly room helps first-time students settle in and focus on learning.
